name: cryptX by Moonshot
tagline: A low-cost hardware wallet for Solana with PIN and seed-phrase security and physical approval.

awards: Best App Dev Track Hack - Bitcamp

problem: Hardware wallets cost around USD 150, the team says.
solution: An Arduino device signs Solana testnet transactions only with physical approval, with PIN and seed authentication and balance monitoring.
demo_moment: Team-described: approve a transfer on the device.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Financial Hack - Capital One” and “Best App Dev Track Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Brings a physical security step to a cheap device.

lessons: Rebuild a costly device cheaply and show it works.
